title: The built-in workflow and step contract registry
description: workflows/registry.json: one row per version of every built-in workflow and per published revision of every step contract, appended and never edited. scripts/workflow-registry.py check reads this schema (it understands type, const, enum, pattern, minimum, minLength, maxLength, required, properties, additionalProperties, patternProperties, items and minItems, and nothing else) and checks the rules a schema cannot say.

pluginVersion.description: The first plugin release that carried this version, or unreleased until the release's prepare step names it.

releasedAt.description: That release's date in US Central time; null while unreleased.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the definition's canonical form, without minPluginVersion.

note.description: One plain sentence on what changed, fit to publish.

dormant.description: No released plugin could run this version when it shipped.

slip.description: A historical row: the content changed without a version bump.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the catalog entry's canonical form, without since.

slip.description: A historical row: the content changed by more than an addition without a new major.
